text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
text.es: Busca las notas de la frase 1: cada una te espera hasta que estés en ella.

text.en: Hociel Thomas, who wrote the words with her father George W. Thomas, became a blues singer and pianist herself, and made records in the mid-1920s.
text.es: Hociel Thomas, que escribió la letra con su padre, George W. Thomas, llegó a ser ella misma cantante y pianista de blues, y grabó discos a mediados de la década de 1920.

source.en: Shorty George Blues (Chicago: Geo. W. Thomas Music Co., 1924), title page; James Head, "Thomas, Hociel", Handbook of Texas Online, Texas State Historical Association (2006, revised 2017); Bill Edwards, "George Washington Thomas", RagPiano.com
source.es: Shorty George Blues (Chicago: Geo. W. Thomas Music Co., 1924), portada; James Head, "Thomas, Hociel", Handbook of Texas Online, Texas State Historical Association (2006, revisado en 2017); Bill Edwards, "George Washington Thomas", RagPiano.com

text.en: George W. Thomas ran his own music publishing company in Chicago, and printed this song himself in 1924.
text.es: George W. Thomas tenía su propia editorial musical en Chicago, y publicó él mismo esta canción en 1924.
